clauses.reason: The sentence places the relations of the United States with the Government of the Northern Mariana Islands under the general administrative supervision of the Secretary of the Interior in all matters not the program responsibility of another Federal department or agency. It has no own-terms end and no held instrument ends or changes it. The U.S. Code prints it as current text, and the Covenant it rests on remains in the Code, so it is operative on 2026-10-14.

research_rationale:
Executive Order 12572 of November 3, 1986 (51 FR 40401), Relations With the Northern Mariana Islands, is one operative sentence in the held Federal Register text: consistent with the Covenant approved by Pub. L. 94-241, the relations of the United States with the Government of the Northern Mariana Islands, in matters not the program responsibility of another Federal department or agency, are placed under the general administrative supervision of the Secretary of the Interior. The held original text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12572.txt) names the order number, date and subject, and the whole order is verified in the packet. Search of held texts for the number EO 12572 finds only the order itself and the 1989 OFR codification (which records no amendment or revocation); the OFR catalog record has no disposition note; the bounded searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog report no machine hit that ends or amends the order. The Office of the Law Revision Counsel U.S. Code release point 119-121 (edition current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted between 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-14 are not reflected in that edition) prints the order as a note and records no ending statement, and the packet holds no source showing a later statute that affects it. The 48 U.S.C. 1801 note prints the same sentence as current text with the label provided. The eCFR search was point-in-time as of 2026-10-14 and found no regulation naming the order. The order's own text has no end date, event or condition; the term-signal records attached to the packet for this order come from the text of the Covenant (48 U.S.C. 1801) and its notes, not from the order, and do not state an end for this command. The order is therefore operative as of 2026-10-14 and was not revoked or superseded on the held evidence.
